title: 17 冯外把总刚才是不是没认出我18 周娘子的狐假虎威
content_zh:
【姓名：曹笔】
【力量：100.9】
【速度：32.8】
【体质：38.4】
【感知：16.3】
【精神：17.4】
曹笔又瞥了一眼脑海里的面板，一百倍力量，三十多倍速度，近四十倍体质……他清晰地知道，自己已经不算普通意义上的人了。
是人形怪物！
可他还在试图做人。
还在试图用那些前世的东西，把自己框在人的范畴里。
他深吸一口气，转身，看向那个跪在地上的独眼壮汉。
“凶骨人？”
声音很平静，平静得像是刚才什么都没发生。
独眼壮汉颤颤巍巍地抬起头，看着他的脸。
那张脸，看起来和普通大宁人没什么两样。
可独眼壮汉知道，就是这张脸，刚才在不到一息的时间里，杀了他二十多个手下。
他不敢站起来，只是跪在那儿，拼命磕头。
一边磕头，一边用不是很标准的大宁话道：“饶命！求求您，饶我一命！！”
……
远处，马蹄声已经近在咫尺。

曹笔抬头看了一眼，眼睛微微眯起。
他能清晰地感觉到被社会主义核心价值观压住的悸动正在往上顶，再顶，猛顶！
他低头看了一眼手里的陨铁刀，上面的血还没干。
他深吸一口气，暗道：“该死，这个世道的诱惑实在是太多了，好不容易憋了回去，一会儿怕是要忍不住了！”
……
尘土飞扬，三百余骑，疾驰而来。
骑兵们冲进村庄，把所有人团团围住。
清一色的制式铠甲，长枪如林，弓箭上弦，动作整齐划一，一看就是精锐。
战马打着响鼻，喷出的白雾在暮色中散开。
马蹄不安地刨着地面，踩碎了满地的血泊。
领头者策马上前，五十出头，国字脸，眼神凌厉如刀。
他扫了一眼满地的无头尸体，眉头都没皱一下，仿佛那些死状凄惨的凶骨人，只是路边的死狗。
然后他看见了那个跪着的独眼壮汉，眼神微微一变。
那变化极快，普通人根本察觉不到。
但他很快收回目光，看向周娘子，看向那几个护卫，最后落在曹笔身上。
一个穿青布长衫的年轻人，手里提着刀，刀上还在滴血。
“拿下。”
领头者冷冷道：“屠村凶手，一个不留！
胆敢反抗，就地格杀！”
周围的士兵齐声应诺，长枪压下，刀剑出鞘，弓箭上弦。

杀气瞬间笼罩全场。
周娘子脸色发白，但她还是上前一步，欠身行礼。
“这位大人！”
她尽量保持着声音的沉稳：“妾身有话要说！”
content_en:
[Name: Cao Bi]
【Power: 100.9】
【Speed: 32.8】
[Physique: 38.4]
[Perception: 16.3]
【Spirit: 17.4】
Cao Bi glanced at the panel in his mind again. One hundred times the strength, more than thirty times the speed, nearly forty times the physique... He clearly knew that he was no longer an ordinary person.
It's a humanoid monster!
But he's still trying to be a human being.
I am still trying to use those things from my past life to frame myself in the category of human beings.
He took a deep breath, turned around, and looked at the one-eyed man kneeling on the ground.
"Skeleton Man?"
The voice was very calm, as calm as if nothing had happened just now.
The one-eyed man raised his head tremblingly and looked at his face.
That face looks no different from an ordinary Daning person.
But the one-eyed man knew that it was this face that had killed more than twenty of his men in less than a breath.
He didn't dare to stand up, so he just knelt there and kowtowed as hard as he could.
While kowtowing, he said in not very standard Daning dialect: "Spare my life! Please, spare my life!!"
…
In the distance, the sound of horse hooves is very close.
Cao Bi looked up and narrowed his eyes slightly.
He could clearly feel that the throbbing suppressed by the core socialist values ​​was pushing up, and then, and harder!
He lowered his head and glanced at the meteorite knife in his hand. The blood on it had not yet dried.
He took a deep breath and said to himself: "Damn it, there are too many temptations in this world. I finally held it back. I'm afraid I won't be able to bear it anymore!"
…
The dust was flying, and more than three hundred horses came galloping towards them.
The cavalry rushed into the village and surrounded everyone.
All wearing standard armor, with spears like a forest, bows and arrows on strings, and uniform movements, they look like elites at first glance.
The war horse snorted, and the white mist it sprayed dispersed in the dusk.
The horse's hooves dug restlessly on the ground, crushing the pool of blood on the ground.
The leader rode forward. He was in his early fifties, with a Chinese character face and eyes as sharp as daggers.
He glanced at the headless corpses on the ground without even frowning, as if those skeletal men with miserable deaths were just dead dogs on the roadside.
Then he saw the kneeling one-eyed man, and his eyes changed slightly.
The change was so rapid that ordinary people couldn't even notice it.
But he quickly retracted his gaze, looked at Madam Zhou, looked at the guards, and finally landed on Cao Bi.
A young man wearing a long green cloth gown held a knife in his hand, with blood still dripping from it.
"Take it."
The leader said coldly: "The murderer who massacred the village, leaving no one alive!
Anyone who dares to resist will be killed on the spot! "
The surrounding soldiers agreed in unison, with their spears lowered, their swords unsheathed, and their bows and arrows cocked.
Murderous aura instantly enveloped the entire audience.
Madam Zhou's face turned pale, but she still took a step forward and bowed.
"This lord!"
She tried to keep her voice calm: "I have something to say!"
